title: Large Language Model-based Optimization for Wireless Communication: A Survey
abstract: arXiv:2611.19876v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The growing complexity and dynamism of modern wireless communication frameworks have made real-time optimization essential for efficient resource allocation. Traditional optimization and machine-learning techniques often struggle with generalization, adaptability, stability, and scalability in heterogeneous, time-varying environments. Large language models (LLMs) have recently emerged as powerful tools capable of reasoning over structured prompts and generating context-aware decisions in real time without domain-specific retraining. This survey provides a comprehensive review of LLM-driven optimization techniques applied to wireless communication problems such as power control, bandwidth allocation, task offloading, and intelligent surface configuration. translated_title: 基于大语言模型的无线通信优化：综述
translated_abstract: 现代无线通信框架日益增长的复杂性和动态性使得实时优化对于高效资源分配变得至关重要。传统优化和机器学习技术在异构、时变环境中往往难以实现泛化、适应性、稳定性和可扩展性。大语言模型（LLMs）近来已成为强大的工具，能够基于结构化提示进行推理并实时生成情境感知的决策，而无需针对特定领域进行重新训练。本综述全面回顾了应用于无线通信问题（如功率控制、带宽分配、任务卸载和智能表面配置）的LLM驱动优化技术。我们引入了一种基于功能的LLM使能无线资源管理策略分类法，并分析了近期文献中采用的提示工程方法。
tldr: 本综述系统梳理了大语言模型在无线通信优化问题（如功率控制、带宽分配、任务卸载和智能表面配置）中的应用，提出了功能分类法并分析了提示工程方法。
en_tdlr: This survey comprehensively reviews LLM-driven optimization techniques for wireless communication problems, introducing a functional taxonomy and analyzing prompt engineering methodologies.
